summary.text: Chaotic Intent Dispels Dream is a wisdom path killer move named when Star Constellation Immortal Venerable uses it.

claims.text: Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s killer move was called chaotic intent dispels dream. It includes a large number of dream path mortal Gu to imitate the power of dream path, and it can influence dream realms. She deduced this move to counter Fang Yuan’s dream realm methods. In the past, Fang Yuan had self-detonated Pure Dream Reality Seeker bodies to create dream realms in battle, then used pure dream reality seeker transformation to turn those realms into clones and take them away. After chaotic intent dispels dream is used, that collection cannot happen. The dream path mortal Gu in the move only have the function of a key. The true method is still wisdom path. She uses the wisdom path method to disturb the will and emotions in a dream realm and make them chaotic. Human path dream realms and heaven path dream realms contain human wills and emotions, or heaven’s will. When those turn chaotic, orderly dream realms lose their order and turn chaotic. Once Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique bodies are struck, their stable human bodies turn back into dream realms, and their human wills and emotions turn disorderly and cannot think. Meng Qiu Zhen, who entered with body and soul, would be torn into pieces by the chaotic dream realm as time passed. Fang Yuan stopped this in time. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable was forced to stop the move, which allowed Meng Qiu Zhen to escape disaster. Deducing chaotic intent dispels dream was already the limit of her ability, because dream path restricted her. She is almost a blank slate in dream path, has no dream path Immortal Gu, and had to use a large number of dream path mortal Gu as replacement. She fully relied on her wisdom path foundation to raise the killer move to rank eight level. That is why she cannot save Fairy Zi Wei and Ying Wu Xie, who are trapped in heaven path dream realms. At most, she could use this killer move to kill them. Activation needs to be maintained. If Fang Yuan disturbs her in that process, she suffers a backlash.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable tried to use chaotic intent dispels dream again and again. Sometimes she had just finished preparing when Fang Yuan caught up to her. Sometimes she had just activated it but had to cancel it to cope with his attacks. After it was activated for a few breaths of time, she was caught in another move and it was forced to stop.

Because Fang Yuan needed to protect Meng Qiu Zhen, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, who had chaotic intent dispels dream, gradually gained the initiative. She started preparing chaotic intent dispels dream, finished preparing, and activated chaotic intent dispels dream. She directly attacked Meng Qiu Zhen.
